content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy. Research shows muscle growth is similar across a wide range of loads, from about 5 to 30 reps, as long as the sets are taken close to failure (roughly 0-3 reps left in the tank). Heavy loads in the 5-10 rep range are still efficient because they need fewer sets to get there.

For your 100 kg bench goal, though, you do need heavy work. Strength is specific, so you have to practice lifting heavy weights. Build muscle with moderate reps (6-12) and add heavy sets in the 3-6 rep range. 💪
